who.title:
Creativity Can
Change the World.
who.body1:
Arts For Tomorrow (AFT) is a youth arts network that
started in Seoul and is expanding to the world.
who.body2: We connect young creators around the world through art, environmental action, exhibitions, publishing and collaborative projects — helping creative ideas grow into meaningful impact.

art.label: Art
art.blurb: We express ideas and values through art.

youth.label: Youth
youth.blurb: We help young voices reach further.

environment.label: Environment
environment.blurb: We protect the planet's tomorrow through creative action.

donation.title:
Creativity Became
Real Impact.
donation.body: In partnership with WWF, AFT youth turned proceeds from their exhibition and youth-designed goods into a real donation for nature — proof that creativity can become action.

global.body: The story AFT began with 28 young creators in Seoul is now growing into a community that connects young artists, creators, thinkers and changemakers around the world. Our world map has only just begun to fill in — and you could be next on it.
global.title:
From Seoul
to the World.
global.body2: We are building a global network that connects young creators and partners, moving toward a better tomorrow.

story.title: Our First Chapter
story.intro: Every global movement starts somewhere. Ours began with 28 young creators in Seoul, asking a simple question — what can art do for the ocean, the environment and our shared future?

project.title: Our Ocean, Our Tomorrow
project.body: Young artists explored the ocean, the environment and our shared future — then carried their work from sketchbook to exhibition to real-world action.

story.tagline: AFT's first youth-led project — from creativity to real-world change.

hero.title: Youth as artists, authors, planners and campaigners — not just participants.
hero.subtitle: AFT is a nonprofit global youth arts organization. Young people explore environmental and social issues through art, then develop their work into exhibitions, publishing, performances, films, products and donation campaigns.

mission.title: Art that doesn't stop at the canvas.
mission.body: AFT connects young people's creativity to real social participation. Members don't just submit artwork — they research issues, form teams, run events, publish books and turn art into products and donations.

teams.title: Youth run the projects, not just make the art.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: AFT values your privacy and complies with applicable data protection laws.
privacy.note: This policy is currently being finalized. Until then, please reach out by email for any privacy-related questions.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect the minimum information needed to provide our services — such as name, email, and contact details — during sign-up, inquiries, and donations. For minors, information is collected with guardian consent.

use.title: How We Use It
use.body: Collected information is used only to provide services, respond to inquiries, run and communicate about programs, and process donations. We do not use it for any other purpose.

retention.title: Retention & Deletion
retention.body: Personal data is securely deleted once its purpose has been fulfilled, in accordance with the periods required by applicable law.

sharing.title: Sharing With Third Parties
sharing.body: We do not share your personal data with third parties without your consent, except where required by law.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction of, deletion of, or suspension of the processing of your personal data at any time.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related questions, please contact hello@aft.org.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The basic terms that apply to your use of the AFT website and programs.
terms.note: These terms are currently being finalized. Until then, please reach out by email for any related questions.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using this website and the services AFT provides, you are deemed to have agreed to these terms.

use.title: Use of Services
use.body: You must use our services in compliance with applicable law and these terms, and must not infringe the rights of others or interfere with the operation of the services.

accounts.title: Membership & Participation
accounts.body: Some services, such as participation in youth programs, require registration, and minors require guardian consent. Information you provide must be accurate.

content.title: Content & Intellectual Property
content.body: Rights to website content — including text, images, and logos — belong to AFT or the respective rights holders, and unauthorized reproduction or distribution is prohibited. Use of youth creative works is governed by separate consent.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, AFT is not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from use of the services.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: AFT may update these terms as needed, and any changes will be announced on this page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, please contact hello@aft.org.

globalNetwork.title: From Seoul to the World.
globalNetwork.body: What began with 28 young creators in Seoul is opening up to young artists, thinkers and changemakers everywhere. This is where the network grows — one real chapter at a time.
globalNetwork.openNote: New cities appear here only when real youth, schools and partners join — the map grows with the movement, not before it.
